versions.changelog:
Incident report generation skill for Chinese and English released.

- Supports fast generation of various online incident/exception reports based on user input.
- Collects six required details: start time, recovery time, description, impact, root cause, and responsible party.
- Offers optional improvement/suggestion section.
- Fills a consistent Markdown report template without inventing or guessing information.
- Prompts user for report output options: copy, send to Feishu, or export as file.
- Enforces language consistency and avoids blame-oriented language.
